title: Mass-balancing strategy enhances the cycling stability of rice husk-derived activated carbon-based supercapacitors in KOH electrolyte
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25940-25948
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03028E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dechen Liu, Wenli Zhang, Haibo Lin, Nan Lin
The strategic increase in the mass ratio of the positive to negative electrodes effectively mitigates the rise of the positive electrode potential, inhibits its oxidative degradation, and enhances the cycle life of supercapacitors.
